name: Sichuan Mahjong
description: Sichuan Mahjong is a Chinese regional Mahjong variant known for fast hand tempo, aggressive discard pressure, and regional rule profiles that emphasize dynamic tactical exchange.

overview.description: Sichuan Mahjong is a Chinese regional Mahjong variant known for fast hand tempo, aggressive discard pressure, and regional rule profiles that emphasize dynamic tactical exchange.

history.origins: Sichuan table rules grew from broader Chinese Mahjong with local simplifications and pressure-oriented round flow.
timeline: 20th century: regional forms spread in Sichuan social play.
Modern era: codified local variants used in clubs and online implementations.
history.cultural: It is a common social tabletop game in Sichuan and nearby regions.
history.evolution: Regional profiles vary in detailed restrictions while preserving fast draw-discard rhythm.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited and honor tiles and optional bonus tiles by table profile.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer starts with 14.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand under the selected Sichuan table profile.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard in sequence. Legal claims for melds follow table restrictions and priority handling. Winning occurs when a complete hand structure and profile scoring criteria are satisfied.
keyRules: Draw then discard each normal turn.
Claim legality and profile-specific restrictions must be enforced.
Winning needs valid hand structure and accepted scoring profile.

strategy.basic: Keep your shape efficient and avoid stranded terminal-heavy tiles unless justified.
strategy.intermediate: Read discard pace to decide when to accelerate value versus safety.
strategy.advanced: Pressure opponents through end-value shaping while preserving your own multi-out completion paths.
tips: Do not overcommit to narrow waits early.
Watch open meld tempo for threat estimation.

synthesis.shortDescription: Sichuan Mahjong is a fast-tempo regional Mahjong variant with classic draw-discard meld flow and local profile settings.
